title: old DZMM GM boundary and per-run emergent narrative contract

reference.principle: LLM drives scene/NPC/plot hooks while Python validates dice, resources, relationships, routes, chapters and endings

changes: vnext narrative rulesets accept free narrate/move turns in addition to authored choices
Run state persists bounded narrative_context with run_seed, current_hook and the latest six turns
model prompts receive narrative memory and a per-run/per-turn variation directive
Ollama, LM Studio and OpenAI-compatible narrative requests use temperature 0.85 and top_p 0.9
player-facing guidance describes authored choices as suggestions and invites direct actions

verification.manual_scope: start the same world twice, use the same opening choice sequence, compare hook/NPC/scene variation and verify Python state outcomes remain valid

residual_risk: The first increment keeps the authored graph as the hard-effect boundary; deeper model-proposed structured events and dynamic endings require a separate schema/acceptance phase.
